plan.title: chore(changelog): convert class-checks/evaluate.ts to isChangelogEntryPath; drop the #6314 allowance

narratives.Description: class-checks/evaluate.ts still exempts the changelog with a literal `CHANGELOG.md` match, so a `changelog.d/` fragment is not exempt there, and entry-path-contract.test.ts carries a TEMPORARY #6327 allowance for that line. This story switches the exemption to `isChangelogEntryPath`, tests a fragment path, and removes the allowance, as one protected-only change set.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

#6314 (CHANGELOG fragments, slice A of #6286) routes every literal `CHANGELOG.md` path match through `isChangelogEntryPath`, except one: `packages/core/src/class-checks/evaluate.ts`. That file is under the class-4 protected glob `packages/core/src/class-checks/**`, and `verify:class-checks` refuses a story change set that touches a protected path together with product paths. So #6314 keeps the literal match there and carries a named temporary allowance for this file in its `packages/core/src/changelog/entry-path-contract.test.ts` (operator decision, 2026-11-15).

This follow-up is a protected-only PR, after #6314's PR #6325 merges:

- `packages/core/src/class-checks/evaluate.ts` matches changelog paths through `isChangelogEntryPath`;
- its test covers a fragment path (`changelog.d/<name>.md`) as well as `CHANGELOG.md`;
- the temporary allowance for this file is removed from `entry-path-contract.test.ts`, so the contract test again fails on any literal match outside the helper.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given a change set that contains `changelog.d/6286-x.md`, then class-checks treats it the same way it treats `CHANGELOG.md`.
- Given the allowance removed, when the entry-path contract test runs, then it passes with no literal `CHANGELOG.md` path match outside `isChangelogEntryPath`.
- The PR changes only protected-path files and that one test file, so `verify:class-checks` admits it as protected-only.

Refs #6286. Refs #6314.

design-critique: not warranted, because this finishes item 1 of the design already accepted on #6286 (lean 6859392664) for the one file a story PR may not touch, and adds no mechanism.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want class-checks to exempt changelog entry paths through `isChangelogEntryPath`, so that a `changelog.d/` fragment is treated like `CHANGELOG.md` and the entry-path contract test has no allowance left for this file.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. In packages/core/src/class-checks/evaluate.ts, replace the literal `posix === "CHANGELOG.md"` exemption in `isExempt` with `isChangelogEntryPath` from ../changelog/entry-path.js.
2. In packages/core/src/class-checks/evaluate.test.ts, add a case where a change set with `changelog.d/6286-x.md` is exempt the same way as `CHANGELOG.md`.
3. In packages/core/src/changelog/entry-path-contract.test.ts, remove the TEMPORARY #6327 allowance and its comment.
4. Add one CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] line. The change set is the protected class-checks files, that one test file, and the free companions (this brief, its mint record, CHANGELOG.md).
